run.question: Which groups of tasks and skill needs do Data/IT job ads fall into?
run.corpus: Job-assistant store: JobTech Data/IT ads since 2026-07 (CC0), current and removed, deduplicated. Not the 35,861-ad 2022-2025 research corpus behind frontend/public/data/jobs/cluster-summary.json.

pipeline.map: 2-D UMAP of the representation (60 neighbours, min_dist 0.08)

limitations: About three months of ads from one occupation field; groups describe this window only.
Cluster ids are run-bound; group names are generated c-TF-IDF terms, not reviewed.
The champion reproduces the research pipeline's semantic text only (no title/technology features, no consensus).
Template stripping is measured per employer on the whole snapshot before the split (no labels involved).
run.label: champion: ml/jobs settings on this corpus

map.method: 2-D UMAP of the representation (60 neighbours, min_dist 0.08)
map.note: Coordinates come from this run's own 2-D UMAP fit. Maps of different runs are not aligned, so a position or a movement between two maps means nothing.
